{{Quote|Desert Demons. I couldn't do anything to stop them, and they are cleaning the place out.|Draci|<ref name="SWG:DC" />}}
'''Draci''' was an individual who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Draci served as a guard for the [[Darklighter cache]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|There is a civil war going on, if you hadn't noticed. Supplies and equipment are going to be in short supply for the civilian population. The Darklighters saw this coming and have been accumulating a cache of supplies to help get though these times.|Draci|<ref name="SWG:DC" />}}
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Draci served as the guard for the [[Darklighter family/Legends|Darklighter family's]] [[Darklighter cache|cache]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The cache was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] used as a storage area, close to the [[Darklighter estate]]. In anticipation of supply shortages due to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Darklighter's relied on the cache to help get themselves through hard times.<ref name="SWG:DC" />

However, In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a criminal gang known as the [[Desert Demons]] blew their way into the cache, and Draci was powerless to stop them. To root out the criminals, Draci entrusted [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] with securing the cache. Draci estimated that the spacers had only about fifteen [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] to eliminate the criminals before everything of value was looted. The spacers who were looking for a cargo smuggled from [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]] assaulted the cave. They eliminated many Desert Demons and accessed the inventory terminals they were looking for.<ref name="SWG:DC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|thumb|250px|Every possible depiction of Draci]]
Draci was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Draci was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> In the game, Draci's species, gender, and appearance would fluctuate after each server reset.<ref name="SWG:DC" />
